title: The `{}` column of the cell-renderer census is objectui#8490 untouched — a checked checkbox, live `mailto:[Object]` anchors with a copy button, an avatar captioned "U", a swatch coloured `[object Object]`
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S`) from the objectui#8580 dev's census, measured while landing PR #8595 and handed over under an explicit MCP-frugality instruction. ⛔ Not claimed.

## The `[]` class is closed. The `{}` class has never been opened.

Three cards measured the empty-array class and it grew each time — objectui#8481 (three multi-value renderers), objectui#8490 / PR #8586 (nine more), objectui#8580 / PR #8595 (markdown / html / richtext). PR #8595's census can finally say it is finished: **25 of 212 cells moved on merged HEAD = #8586's 19 + #8595's 6, nothing else**, and the only `[]` rows still differing from `null` are objectui#8481's declared json-literal fence.

**PR #8586 deliberately left `{}` unchanged everywhere.** That was the right scoping decision and it was never a claim that `{}` is fine. Measured on merged HEAD `e122a5e95`, rendering all 53 registered types, here is what `{}` draws:

| renderer family | `{}` renders |
|---|---|
| `boolean` / `toggle` | a **CHECKED** checkbox |
| `email` / `url` / `phone` | a **live anchor** — `href="mailto:[Object]"`, `tel:[Object]` — **plus a copy button** |
| `user` | an avatar stack with initial **U**, labelled **User** |
| `select` / `status` / `multiselect` / `radio` / `checkboxes` / `tags` | the literal text `[Object Object]` |
| `color` | a swatch whose `background` is the string `[object Object]` |
| `file` / `video` / `audio` | one chip named **File** |
| `date` | a hand-rolled em-dash with **no accessible name** |
| `location` / `geolocation` | the `{}` literal (objectui#8481's json-literal fence) |
| `number` / `currency` / `percent` / `slider` / `rating` / `text` / `code` / `formula` / `lookup` | `[Object]` — the string class's answer, **consistent** |

The last row is the tell: where a family has a declared coercion, `{}` lands on it correctly. Everywhere else the renderer invents something, and several of the inventions are **assertions the record never made** or **affordances that cannot work** — a live `mailto:[Object]` with a copy button is the exact shape PR #8586 removed for `[]`.

## ⛔ Two of these rows are already spoken for — do not take them here

- **`boolean` / `toggle`** is objectui#8582 / PR #8594 territory, and its ruling is already made from four spec instruments: a `boolean` field holds a JS boolean, so a non-boolean is **no value**. That PR fixed `{}` for boolean along with the rest. Verify it landed before touching this row; if it did, this table's first line is already stale.
- **`location` / `geolocation`** sit behind objectui#8481's **declared** json-literal fence. Leave them or reopen that fence deliberately — do not sweep them.

## ⚠️ The direction is NOT open per family — read the spec first

PR #8595 established the pattern: for the string family the spec settles `{}` **away from** the "no value" affordance and **toward** the family's existing coercion (`STRING_VALUE_TYPES` — *"Value is a plain string"*; write seam `z.string()`). It then pinned the result **byte-equal to what `text` prints for `{}`**, so the rule stays true without being restated.

⇒ Do the same per family. **`@objectstack/spec` has settled four of these questions today already** (objectui#8555, objectui#8497, objectui#8582, objectui#8580) — in every case the answer existed and in one it was the opposite of what the PM guessed. Read `valueSchemaFor`'s arm for each family before choosing, and report what you found even where it confirms the obvious.

⚠️ Where the spec is silent, the safe answer is the family's **existing** coercion, not a new renderer-side fallback — a fallback invented here is the AGENTS.md #0.1 second dialect.

## ⭐ Evidence bar

Use the instrument that found this: **render all 53 registered types against `[]`, `{}`, `''` and `null`** on a pinned base and diff the cells. A regex over class strings under-counted this class three separate times.

The caricature is drawing the shared `EmptyValue` for every `{}` — it satisfies *"the checked checkbox is gone"* while erasing the families whose coercion is correct. **Your load-bearing cases are the 9 consistent rows staying byte-identical**, plus every populated value.

⚠️ **An assertion never observed to fail has not been tested.** PR #8595 found one of its own passing on the caricature because it compared `undefined` to `undefined`. Run the caricature; read failure **modes**, not counts. ⚠️ Prove every mutation on disk in **both** directions **plus a line-total gate**, and count harness-death signatures separately — objectui#8490 lost a leg to an empty file that a deleted-text-only gate accepted, and objectui#8582 turned that accident into a control worth copying.

## Related

objectui#8490 / PR #8586 (the `[]` half, and the deliberate `{}` exclusion) · objectui#8580 / PR #8595 (the census that closed `[]` and produced this table) · objectui#8481 (the json-literal fence) · objectui#8582 / PR #8594 (the boolean ruling, and the `{}` row it already covers) · objectui#8581 (`DateCellRenderer`'s hand-rolled dash — the `date` row here is the same renderer)

## Dedup

⚠️ **Declared, NOT claimed.** This repo's issue search returns **false zeros** — measured five times today, including `total_count: 0` for `ValueDataSource` while objectui#8447's own title carries that word. **No dedup claim is made.** Suggested manual check: objectui#8490's thread and objectui#8481.
